title: Let only genuine requests through to the network

cases.says: a purchase signed by a known terminal reaches the network and comes back approved
a request changed after the terminal signed it is refused with 63 and never reaches the network
a request with no MAC at all is refused like a forged one
a terminal with no key on file is answered 63 rather than left without an answer
what the network receives carries no MAC under the terminal's key
a PIN purchase reaches the network with the PIN under the key the network shares, so the network can check it
a PIN purchase whose PIN can't be translated is refused with 96 and never reaches the network, not sent on without its PIN

origin.section: 7.3 A PIN Block Is Safe Only While Its Key and the LMK Stay Apart
